title: Vernox Working On Solara
features:
Working on Solara!
[+] Universal Autofarm : Great for super rebirths. Farms absolutely all zones, from 1 to 20.
[+] Zone Autofarm : Farms a specific zone. Good enough if you want to get a lot of wins.
[+] Select Zone : Select a zone for Zone Autofarm.

[+] Destroy tabs : Destroys signs with ads/products for robux
[+] Destroy eggs for robux : Destroys eggs that cost robux.
[+] Destroy Doors : Destroys doors that you need wins to enter.
[+] Auto Rebirth : Good for AFK farming. Just turn it on and auto train. In an hour you will definitely be on the leaderboard.
[+] Auto Super Rebirth : Also good for AFK farming. Turn it on, and Universal Farm, and you will quickly accumulate winnings and rebirths.
[+] Rebirth : Rebirth.
[+] Super Rebirth : Super rebirth. For it, you need to have 200+ billion winnings. To get it quickly, turn on Universal Autofarm
[+] Redeem codes : Activates existing codes.
